paragraphs.source_en: Fusahime took the cup. She had once married Takeda Magohachirō for the sake of revenge, but now, determined to restore the Kyōgoku family’s honor, she had finally resolved to marry Hideyoshi. Hideyoshi gazed tenderly and intently at Fusahime, waiting for her to drain the wine in her cup.

paragraphs.source_en: What time had a man who risked life and limb every day to pursue an innocent romance? Had he spent every day chasing women, he would never have achieved the greatness that awaited him. After Fusahime had drained her cup, Hideyoshi said, “Sometimes even I do foolish things.”
